fact: The ministry's statistical yearbook for 2021 states that the monthly reports of first-tier facilities (health centres and improved health centres) are either entered in the DHIS2 platform or sent to the health district teams for entry after validation, the DPS/DCS keying them by the 20th of the following month, while CMCs and prefectural, regional and national hospitals enter directly; it gives no number or share of health centres entering their own reports.
title: Annuaire statistique sanitaire 2021
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l’Hygiène Publique, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement
